## Project
broMarquee is a free, lightweight, dependency-free JavaScript library for building smooth, infinite logo marquees in Webflow with real user control (drag, wheel, touch, inertia).

## Primary pages
- Home: https://marquee.bro-design.pro/
- Get started guide: https://marquee.bro-design.pro/#how-to-use
- FAQ: https://marquee.bro-design.pro/#faq
- Contributing / Support: https://marquee.bro-design.pro/#contributing

## Installation (Webflow)
1) Add the broMarquee script via CDN in the <head> of your page or project.
2) Copy and paste the broMarquee component from this site into your Webflow project using Designer mode:
   https://marquee.bro-design.pro/#how-to-use
3) The component already includes all required attributes and structure — no manual configuration is needed.

## Key features
- Smooth infinite marquee loop
- Real user control: mouse drag, touch swipe, trackpad/mouse wheel
- Inertia (natural momentum)
- Autoplay + user override
- Multiple marquees per page, optional sync
- Works with Webflow CMS-rendered items

## Usage notes
- Optimize logo images (size/format) for best performance.
- For accessibility: provide meaningful alt text for informative logos; use empty alt for purely decorative logos.
